# jamfplatform_blueprints_blueprint (List Resource)

Searches for Jamf Blueprints with an optional case-insensitive substring filter.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Deployment | Blueprints | Read | `blueprints` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "jamfplatform_blueprints_blueprint" "software_update" {
  provider = jamfplatform

  config {
    search = "software update"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Optional substring to match against blueprint name or description (case-insensitive).
